name: Ink Blob Cursor
description: A WebGL cursor effect for React: an ink blot trails the pointer, its edge torn into splashes and droplets by a drifting voronoi noise field, and text over it flips from dark to light with a difference blend wherever the ink passes. Grainy dithered page, an opening where the ink fills the screen and draws back. Raw WebGL2, one pass.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the ink, set in white with a difference blend (dark on the page, light on the ink).

props.name: size
props.description: Blob diameter, as a share of the width.

props.name: follow
props.description: How far the blob follows the cursor (1 = all the way, 0 = stays centred).

props.name: ease
props.description: How quickly it catches up (higher = snappier).

props.name: intro
props.description: Open with the ink filling the screen and drawing back to size.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
